steps.en: A monthly report is generated automatically every month
steps.id: Laporan bulanan dibuat otomatis setiap bulan

steps.en: The report lists notices paid during that month
steps.id: Laporan memuat notice yang dibayar sepanjang bulan itu
steps.why_en: Selection follows the suspension date and keeps only the latest payment per notice.
steps.why_id: Pemilihan mengikuti tanggal suspension dan hanya menyimpan pembayaran terakhir per notice.

steps.en: The report separates collections at other agencies' car parks such as JTC and MND
steps.id: Laporan memisahkan koleksi di car park agensi lain seperti JTC dan MND
steps.why_en: Every non-URA car park is labelled JTC, MND is not separated, and part-payments are left out of that sheet.
steps.why_id: Semua car park non-URA diberi label JTC, MND tidak dipisah, dan pembayaran kurang tidak masuk sheet itu.

steps.en: The report carries the notice details listed in the story
steps.id: Laporan memuat detail notice yang disebut di story
steps.why_en: No single sheet has all fields; the agency sheet lacks receipt number and payment source, other sheets lack vehicle and offence details.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada satu sheet yang memuat semua field; sheet agensi tanpa nomor receipt dan sumber bayar, sheet lain tanpa kendaraan dan pelanggaran.

steps.en: The report gives monthly totals per channel and for other agencies
steps.id: Laporan memberi total bulanan per channel dan untuk agensi lain
steps.why_en: The agency total counts part-payments that the agency sheet leaves out, so figures can disagree.
steps.why_id: Total agensi menghitung pembayaran kurang yang tidak ada di sheet agensi, jadi angka bisa tidak cocok.

steps.en: The monthly Excel file is generated and emailed as an attachment
steps.id: File Excel bulanan dibuat dan dikirim lewat email sebagai lampiran

steps.en: The email goes to URA Finance
steps.why_en: The recipient list holds individual staff addresses; none can be confirmed as URA Finance from the code.
steps.why_id: Penerima berisi alamat staf perorangan; tidak ada yang bisa dipastikan sebagai URA Finance dari code.
